historikk.lede: From the strategy's own Myfxbook record — a standard Tag Markets account at 1:500 — from 3 November 2024 to 14 October 2026. Each bar is one month's gain; the mark below it is that month's largest dip. The 30 % fee you pay is not taken out of these figures. Past results, not a forecast.
notes: No losing month in 24 — which also means this record has not yet been tested by one.
Losing days happen: 49 of the 427 daily readings. The worst, −0.64 % on 3 June 2025, is about −15 % of your deposit in one day at 24×; the deepest dip, −0.86 %, about −21 %.
The average loss ($134.97) is bigger than the average win ($93.37). The high win rate carries the result, so a run of losses costs more than a run of wins earns.
The account closes at 5 %. The record's deepest dip, 0.86 %, is about a sixth of that distance.
Dips here are measured on each day's closing balance; inside a day they can go deeper. The record has gaps — the longest is 20 August to 12 September 2025 — and each counts as a single reading.

The strategy card inside CopyX labels 0.26 % as «Max DD». A slide in AiTech's presentation calls 0.26 % the average drawdown and 0.86 % the deepest. Myfxbook's deepest is 0.86 %, and that is the one we use.
historikk.formula: Effect on your deposit = the account's fall in % × 24.

uttak.lede: Profit can come out any time; the deposit only 30 days after your first trade, and taking it out closes the account. The path has three parts, and the middle one is only needed the first time. Do it once early, with a small amount, so you know it works before you rely on it.

parts.tittel: From Amplify to your Tag wallet
parts.tekst: On the Dashboard, open AMPLIFY. Profit you can take out is shown under AVAILABLE. Press WITHDRAW, enter the amount, press WITHDRAW again, then CONTINUE. The back office reviews it, so it can take a while to appear in your Tag Markets Wallet — refresh the page.

parts.tittel: First time only: add your own wallet
parts.tekst: Open TAG WALLET → YOUR CRYPTO WALLETS → ADD A CRYPTO WALLET. Fill in the owner's name, choose CRYPTO, add your billing details and the address of your own wallet, enter your dashboard password and press SUBMIT CRYPTO WALLET. It shows PENDING VALIDATION — usually 5 to 45 minutes, up to 24 hours.

parts.tittel: From your Tag wallet to your own wallet
parts.tekst: TAG WALLET → WITHDRAWALS. Enter the amount and press SUBMIT REQUEST, tick the box, press «Your attention is required. Please click here», enter the wallet you verified, and choose CRYPTOCHILL — without it the withdrawal is not processed and you have to start again. Check the details and press WITHDRAW.

uttak.facts: The broker's minimum withdrawal is $10 on Ethereum (ETH), BNB (BSC) and Bitcoin (BTC), and $50 on Tron (TRX). A network fee is deducted, and it depends on the network — so what arrives is roughly the amount minus the network fee. The broker says Amplify payouts take 1–3 working days, and crypto withdrawals 2–24 hours for amounts up to $999, up to 48 hours for amounts up to $4,999, and up to 72 hours above that. Profit in CopyX can also be taken out from Follower Hub, Strategies, Withdraw; it then lands in your Tag Markets wallet. Withdrawals go back first to the method you deposited with, newest deposit first — if you deposited by card, the withdrawal goes to the card first.

faq.lede: Short answers to what people ask. Search, or tap a question.
faq.none: No question matches that. Ask in the Aimpire group — someone has usually wondered the same.

items.a:
It is a fair question, and you should ask it about anything involving money.

What you can check yourself: your money sits with the broker, never with Aimpire or your sponsor; profit can be withdrawn whenever you ask; and the rules on this page are quoted from the broker's and the platform's own pages.

So put in only what you can afford to lose completely. Nobody can promise you that the strategy keeps making money.

Check for yourself: look at the history on Myfxbook (under Sonic → Record), and withdraw a small amount early — then you know withdrawals work before you put in more.

That is for you to decide — scholars see trading differently. Here is how it works in practice:

⏱️ A trade lasts about 4 hours on average — Sonic trades within the day.
🚫 The strategy account shows $0 in interest (swap) on Myfxbook.
🕌 The broker also has an Islamic account type, without swap.
🧾 There are small fees, like commission per lot. Those are fees, not interest.
The broker, Tag Markets — not Aimpire and not your sponsor. Never send money to a person, and only deposit from inside your own portal.

items.q: How much do I need to start?
items.a: The minimum is $10, both for the deposit and for connecting Sonic. Start with an amount you could lose completely, and watch it for a few weeks before you decide on more. Note: $10 has to arrive after the fees, so send a little more.

items.q: Is this allowed in my country?
items.a:
Rules differ between countries and change, so check your own before you deposit — we cannot give legal advice. Two separate things matter.

The broker's own list: the broker publishes an up-to-date list on its own website of where it operates. That list can change, so read it at the source before you register — don't rely on anyone's summary, including ours.

Your own country's rules: these are about you, not the broker. Check what your central bank or financial regulator says about sending money abroad for trading, and ask your bank if you are unsure. In Pakistan this is covered by the State Bank's EPD Circular Letter No. 08 of 2022 — read it before you deposit. The broker's list says nothing about that.
Two, both free: MetaTrader 5 to see your account, and Element X for the Aimpire group. Install them from the official stores only. Tag Markets and CopyX run in your browser.

The broker says verification «just takes a few minutes», with delays when demand is high or documents are incomplete. You need an ID document and a face scan. If it is rejected, the reason comes by email from SumSub. Use any waiting time for step 6, the apps.

With the Aimpire token your money trades 24 times larger: in our own test, $109 became a trading balance of $2,616. Gains and losses are both 24 times larger. A fall of 4.2 % in that balance is your whole deposit, and the account closes at 5 %.

The Sonic strategy takes a 30 % performance fee on profit, so you keep about 70 % of the profit — the Amplify section explains why it can be less. There is no management fee and no joining fee. On Amplify accounts the broker also charges $10 per lot in commission on forex and metals. Then there are the costs any trade has: the spread, swap on positions held overnight, and network fees when you deposit or withdraw crypto.

Profits: yes, you can withdraw them at any time, any day. Your deposit: only 30 days after your first trade, and taking it out closes the account immediately. An upgrade starts those 30 days again. The broker says payouts take 1–3 working days. The steps are under «Sonic» → «Withdrawals».

Yes. In CopyX open Follower Hub, then Strategies, press Reinvest on the strategy, enter the amount and press Upgrade. Know this first: the broker says an upgrade restarts the 30 days before your deposit can be taken out.

items.q: Is there a daily loss limit?
items.a: No daily limit. There is one total limit: 10 % of the starting balance, or 5 % with the Aimpire token. Reach it and the account is closed automatically.
No. Nothing here is guaranteed. Published results — Myfxbook included — are past results from the strategy's own account, without the fee you pay — not a forecast.

items.q: How do I know the token worked?
items.a: Look at the balance in MetaTrader 5: with the token it is 24 times what you put in. If it is not, stop and ask your sponsor before you do anything else.

items.q: Someone says I need eCredits, or must send crypto, to get 24×.
items.a:
Not through Aimpire. Our token is #Aitech with the code 000000, and you send nothing for it. The platform also has an «#eCredits» route: there you send as many eCredits as you invest to a wallet address, so $100 means 100 eCredits on top of your deposit.

If anyone asks you to send money or crypto anywhere other than your own deposit page, stop and ask your sponsor.

items.q: Can I have more than one account?
items.a: Yes. The broker says you may hold as many as you want, as long as each one follows the rules.

Check the transaction in your own wallet first — the portal cannot show money that never reached it. Your wallet's own estimate can say up to 24 hours. After that, send your sponsor the transaction ID, never a screenshot of your login.

A wrong network can mean the money never arrives — wallets warn of «permanent loss of funds». Contact your wallet's own support with the transaction ID straight away. Nobody in Aimpire can reverse a crypto transfer.

items.q: Someone says they are support and asks for my password.
items.a: Do not give it — not to support, not to a leader, not to anyone. Aimpire will never ask for it. If someone needs to see your results, give them the Investor Password: it can only look, not trade.
The broker has its own guide for changing it, under «Get set up» → «Guides that already exist». Never ask anyone in a chat to reset it for you.

items.q: Do I have to invite other people?
items.a: No. You can open an account, let Sonic run and never introduce anyone. Earning as an introducing broker is optional, and nothing on the platform requires it.

items.q: How do I get a statement for my taxes?
items.a: The MetaTrader 5 terminal on a Windows computer can export it: open the History tab at the bottom, right-click, choose Export and save it as HTML, then print that to PDF. Keep the receipts for every deposit and withdrawal too. The rules depend on your country, and we cannot give tax advice.

First this page. Then your sponsor — the person who invited you — for anything about your account. If money does not arrive or something seems wrong, your sponsor takes it further. And ask in the Aimpire group: someone has usually had the same question.

items.q: When does the market move the most?
items.a: Around scheduled news. The economic calendar marks each release with an expected impact, and the strongest — like interest-rate decisions — are marked High. The minutes around a High release can move prices fast, in both directions, and spreads often widen. Many wait out about 15 minutes on each side of a High release before judging anything. Note: the calendar feed shows New York time, so convert it to your own clock. You find the calendar under Tools.

items.q: I see an old version of the page
items.a: If a button at the top says a new version is ready, tap it. Otherwise close every Aimpire tab in your browser and open the link again from your sponsor's message. Still the old page? Reload it once — on a phone, pull the page down. As a last check you can open the link in a private window (Chrome: Incognito, Safari: Private), but a private window forgets your sponsor and your progress when you close it.

inntekt.intro: Optional. Four ways it can pay, and one warning: your real numbers live only in your IB Portal — never in a chat message.
items: Part of the trading cost comes back on every lot your team trades. Paid on activity. No trading, no rebate.
When a strategy closes a winning trade, the profit is split. The person whose money is in the account keeps the largest share.
As people you introduced start trading, more levels of the structure can open. Your IB Portal shows which are open and which are still locked — the numbers on that screen are the ones that count.
Leader pools and seasonal campaigns come and go. Read the current terms before you count on one.
inntekt.warning: Trading involves real risk, and most retail accounts lose money. What you earn here depends on actual activity — there is no guaranteed income, and it can be nothing. We would rather be honest with you about that from the start.

ib.lede: This part is optional. You can open an account, let Sonic run, and never introduce a single person. Nothing on the platform requires it. It is here because people ask how it works, and because half-explained money is how communities go wrong.

blocks.tekst: The broker already charges a spread and a commission on every trade, whether you introduced anyone or not. An Introducing Broker gets a share of what the broker earns. That is the usual mechanism across the industry, and it is not a separate fee on the person you introduced. On Sonic there is one more thing to know: part of what the people above you earn comes from the member's own 30 % performance fee. The fee is the same either way, but it is the member who pays it.

The plan has ten generations. They start locked. Your IB Portal shows two lines that decide everything: «# of Directs with active Trading account» and «Generations unlocked». Generations open only when your directs — the people you introduced yourself — have active trading accounts. Until then, the level-based streams pay nothing on the locked levels. How they open, according to the Tag Markets presentation other teams use: you need at least $250 in trading yourself, which opens the first three levels. Levels four to ten open as up to ten people you introduced directly each have $250 in trading. The portal does not show the rate per level.

AiTech's own presentation of 3 October 2026 shows two versions of the programme. The international one, for members outside Europe, pays on ten levels: 2.5 % of each trade's profit per level, and per lot $2.00, $1.50, $1.00, $1.00 and then $0.50 on levels five to ten — up to $8.50 per lot in all. The European one pays on one level only: 2.5 % that can rise to 22.5 % with volume, $2.00 per lot that can rise to $6.50, and a general bonus of $2.00 per lot plus a bonus payment. In the CopyX app that general bonus has steps at $10,000, $50,000, $200,000 and $500,000 of team volume.

The broker's own help centre documents a third table for its amplified accounts — $3.00, $1.20 and $0.60 on three levels. That table may belong to Tag Markets' own partner plan rather than AiTech's. The same help centre says a trade only counts for commission if it stays open for at least 3 minutes.

blocks.tittel: How the bonus model is drawn
blocks.tekst:
The presentation draws it in five parts. First the split of every trade's profit: 70 % stays with the member, 5 % goes to the developers, and 25 % is shared ten levels down in the structure — the 2.5 % per level above. Then the per-lot commission, the leader pools with an ambassador rate of $2.00 per lot, «CPA» on the new money deposited in your network, and incentives.

For CPA and the pools the presentation and the portal show how much volume each step needs — see «The nine streams, by name». When each of the ten levels opens depends on your directs, as «The lock nobody explains» describes. Ask your sponsor to show you your own figures in the IB Portal before you count on any of it. The presentation marks the programme «subject to local restrictions» and «only available to professional Influencer».

blocks.tittel: A worked example with real sizes
blocks.tekst:
Suppose twenty members each put in $100. At 24× each trades as $2,400. Copying the strategy's own volume — about 4.5 lots a month on about $130,000 — twenty such accounts trade about 1.7 lots a month between them. At $2.00 per lot on the first level, that is about $3.30 a month, and only once that level is open.

The volume comes from the strategy and from how much your members put in, not from anything you control. Run the number for your own team, not the one in someone's screenshot.

blocks.tittel: The formula, so you can put your own numbers in
blocks.tekst: monthly rebate ≈ members × trades each × lots per trade × rate per lot. Every part after the ≈ sign is yours to check: the lot size depends on your leverage, and the rate depends on which programme your agreement is under. Put in your own numbers and the answer is yours, not someone else's claim.

So you recognise them in the portal rather than in a chat message: Lot Commissions, Profit Share, CPA Earnings, Leader Pool 1 and 2, Sonic Pool, Profit Pool, NeoFX Pool and Super Sonic Bonus. «CPA Earnings» is not paid per person. It is a monthly percentage of the new money your whole team deposits — from 1 % at $10,000 to 7.5 % at $100,000,000 — counted after a «50% rule», so no more than half may come from your strongest line, and paid as the difference to anyone below you who qualifies too. One overview slide in the presentation calls it a payment per qualified registration; the portal and the presentation's own table show it as a percentage of deposits. Leader Pool 1 starts at $500,000 of team volume, Leader Pool 2 at $1,000,000. Payouts are made in USDT.

No income is guaranteed and it can be zero. Everything above depends on other people depositing and trading, which depends on them choosing to, which you do not control. Treat it as a share of activity that may happen, not as a plan.

items.tittel: What Sonic is, and the choice that is yours
items.tekst:
Sonic is the strategy your account copies: its trades run in your account by themselves. It only runs amplified, on Amplify — there is no smaller version to start with. So the choice that protects you is the amount.

Put in less if any of these is true: losing all of it would change your month; you have never watched a trade go against you; this is your first trading account.

Start with an amount you could lose completely, and watch it for a few weeks. If you add money later, know that an upgrade restarts the 30-day clock on your deposit.

items.tittel: Amplify: you trade a multiple of your deposit
items.tekst:
Amplify is a funded account: you trade a multiple of what you put in, and it is real money. The broker's standard multiple is 12×; with the Aimpire token it is 24×.

In our own test, $109 became a trading balance of $2,616. The multiple works on losses exactly as it does on gains.

items.tittel: When the account closes, in the platform's own words
items.tekst:
«If the manager loses more than 10% of starting balance, your account will be liquidated.»

With the token, the form adds: «By using a token code, your Amplify account draw down limit will change to 5% of your starting balance.»

In money: your $109 trades as $2,616. A fall of 1 ÷ 24 = 4.2 % in that balance equals your whole $109 — before the 5 % line is even reached. The line is a hard trigger: the account closes by itself, with no waiting for prices to come back. That is why the amount matters most.

The community token field is where Aimpire's token goes. Type #Aitech, press Verify, then enter 000000 in the Hash field that appears. Without a valid token the account opens at 12× with the 10 % line, instead of 24× with the 5 % line. Check that the tick shows before you press Copy Now.

items.tittel: What the platform says about who is responsible
items.tekst: Before you can submit, you tick a box that says trades on CopyX are provided by traders unaffiliated with Tag Markets, and that Tag Markets bears no responsibility or liability for the trades or their outcomes. Read it before you tick it. It means the broker holding your money is not answerable for what the strategy does with it.

items.tittel: What you keep when it makes money
items.tekst:
The presentation gives the split as 70 / 5 / 25, marked «per trade»: 70 % of the profit to you, 5 % to the developers who run the system, 25 % to what it calls «the team» — «How the bonus model is drawn» shows that part. On the Sonic card it shows as a 30 % performance fee, with no management fee and no joining fee.

So $100 of profit is about $70 to you — less if the fee is taken on each winning trade rather than on the net result. The card says «Schedule 1 Week» but does not say whether the fee is worked out on each trade or on the week's net result. Ask your sponsor.

Published results, Myfxbook included, show the strategy's own account. The 30 % fee is charged to followers, so it is not taken out of those curves.

items.tittel: The rules, from the broker's own help centre
items.tekst:
You can withdraw profits at any time, any hour, any day; the broker says the payout then takes 1–3 working days.

Your original deposit can only be taken out 30 days after your first trade — not 30 days after you paid in — and taking it out closes the account immediately. Upgrading the account starts that 30-day clock again.

There is no daily loss limit, only the 10 % line (5 % with the community token), and you may hold as many of these accounts as you want.

items.tittel: Commission and leverage, measured on your own money
items.tekst:
Commission on an amplified account is $10 per lot on forex and metals, charged when the trade closes. For indices and crypto the broker's own help articles give two different answers: one says $10 per lot on everything, another says $1 on indices and nothing on crypto.

The form shows leverage 1:30, but it applies to the multiplied balance. Measured against your own deposit, 24 × 30 = 720:1 — more than the 1:500 of a standard account, not less. At 12× it is 360:1.

juridisk.legal:
Aimpire is a learning community. We are not a broker, we do not take deposits, we do not manage anyone's money, and we do not give financial advice.

The rules for trading with a broker in another country are not the same everywhere, and in some countries they are restricted. Find out what applies where you live before you put money in — that decision, and what follows from it, is yours. Leaders here share what they have learned; they do not advise, and they do not handle anyone's money. Everything shared in the community — charts, examples, signals — is for learning, so you can judge for yourself; it is never a recommendation to buy or sell.

The prices in the app come from gold-api.com, and the row with indices and currency pairs is an embedded ticker from TradingView. When it loads, the request goes to TradingView with your IP address, as it does with any website you visit. The news comes from Forex Factory.
juridisk.risk: Trading involves risk and you can lose the money you put in. Nothing here is financial advice, and no income is promised. Use only money you can afford to lose, and check the rules that apply where you live.

tekst.title: See your own progress
tekst.lede: The numbers are already on your phone. Here is where to find them and how to work out where you stand. Nothing is sent to us.
mt5: Open MetaTrader 5 and log in to your account.
Choose the period at the top.
At the bottom you see Deposit (deposits minus withdrawals), Profit (gain or loss) and Balance (what you have now).
portal: Open Tag Wallet. Net Deposits is what you have put in, minus withdrawals.
Open Accounts → Account Summary and tap + next to your Real account. Equity is the value now, including open trades.
Do not tap Real, Demo or Social Trading at the top. They open a new account.
If there is money left in Tag Wallet (Balance at the top), add it to the value now.
tekst.dep: Put in: Net Deposits or Deposit ($)
tekst.up: Up {D} ({P}) on what you put in.
tekst.down: Down {D} ({P}) on what you put in.
tekst.note: Calculated only on your phone. Not saved, not sent.
tekst.warn: Balance does not include open trades, Equity does. What happened before says nothing certain about the future. Never type a password here.

tekst.title: Losing streaks — try it yourself
tekst.lede: Even a sound method has long runs of losses. Pick the numbers and see 1,000 random runs of 100 trades each. This is a dice game, not a forecast.
tekst.rr: Win size compared with loss size (×)
tekst.dd50: Runs that fell 50 % below the start
tekst.end_below: Runs that ended below the start
tekst.note: Each trade here is a coin with your win rate — real trades are not that tidy. The point is the shape: losing streaks are normal, and the risk per trade decides whether you get through them.

tekst.title: How much does a gold trade tie up?
tekst.lede: Margin is the money the broker holds aside while your trade is open. See what a gold trade ties up — and what a $1 move in gold means for you. A calculation, not advice.
tekst.price: Gold price — live, you can change it
tekst.check: A contract is usually 100 ounces per 1.00 lot, and leverage depends on your account. Check Specification in MT5 before you trade.

tekst.title: Fibonacci levels
tekst.lede: Many traders look at these levels after a big move. Enter the top and the bottom — the levels are maths, not a signal.
tekst.note: These are levels many people watch, not places where price must turn. Use them to learn, never as a buy or sell signal.
